meta.source: Shoghmoum Main Logo + Main Identity Mat (Illustrator 30.3, 2026-07-25) + approved decisions Aug–Oct 2026

status_legend.proposed: recommendation for the website, needs owner confirmation

maroon.usage: Primary. Dark ground, text on light grounds, logo ink, illustration ink.

sand.usage: Secondary. Light ground, text on maroon, logo on maroon.

terracotta.usage: Accent on LIGHT grounds only (eyebrow labels, series names on sand, secondary emphasis). Never text on maroon (2.21:1).

gold.usage: The single highlight: one brush swipe per view, callout bar, dashed guide lines/arrows on maroon, series name on maroon. Must render as pure #AA8302 (never with opacity).

gold-light.usage: Highlights inside engraved illustrations only. Never text or UI.

black.usage: Approved only as one of the four alternating grounds of the Instagram highlight covers. Not a website colour unless approved.

periwinkle.usage: In the Sept-2026 palette but deliberately unused so far. Do not use without approval.

aqua.usage: In the Sept-2026 palette but deliberately unused so far. Do not use without approval.

color-rejected.#E6E7E2: Appears on the logo artboards of the source file — an export error/near-duplicate of sand. Never use; use #E9EAD9.

color-usage-ratio (proposed for web).why: Grounds of alternating sections + all body text on sand.
Grounds of alternating sections + text on maroon. Together maroon + sand ≈ 85–90% of every screen.
Eyebrows / labels / secondary emphasis on sand only.
ONE highlight per screen view + callout bars + dashed guides. If it appears everywhere it stops being a highlight.
Reserved — not on the website until approved.

contrast.verdict: Large text / UI only (≥24px or ≥18.66px bold)
Large text / UI only (≥24px or ≥18.66px bold)

family-latin.status: proposed: IBM Plex Sans Arabic carries Latin glyphs; IBM Plex Sans is its sibling for long English pages

font.logo-font: Greta Arabic (Typotheque, commercial) — used ONLY inside the outlined logo. Never set new text in it.
rejected: Noto Kufi Arabic + Readex Pro pairing (tried and rejected)
font.numerals: Arabic-Indic digits (١٢٣) inside Arabic copy; Latin digits only in Latin copy, codes, phone numbers in links.

label/eyebrow.color: terracotta on sand / sand or gold on maroon

callout (\"السكة\").note: or 36/600 on dense slides; 8px gold bar on its inline-start edge; must stand out more than body

layout.rhythm: edge · indent · edge — headline flush to the text edge, divider rule and body indented (~8–9% of the column), callout back to the edge
layout.block-placement: text blocks optically centred, not pinned to the bottom edge; on repeated layouts lock the heading to the same height
layout.section-ground: alternate maroon / sand; two consecutive sections on the same ground is a mistake (rule from the carousels)
layout.radius: 0–4px (brand is architectural and sharp; avoid pill buttons except small chips)

measuring-grid.what: شبكة القياس — a faded draughtsman grid behind drawings. Owner calls it one of the most beautiful elements of the identity.
measuring-grid.step: 30px on a 1080 canvas (2.78% of width); web: 24px mobile / 30px desktop
measuring-grid.color: the INK of the ground (sand lines on maroon, maroon lines on sand)
measuring-grid.mask: radial fade: 100% at centre → 70% at half radius → 0 at edge. Strongest under the drawing it supports, gone before it reaches text.
rules: never a uniform texture over a whole page
it is the base a drawing stands on, not wallpaper

pattern.grid: 493.9 × 373.0 units (ratio 1.324), one motif per cell, centred
pattern.opacity: 7% as all-over texture · ~9% for the large cropped icon watermark
pattern.colour: ink of the ground (sand on maroon, maroon on sand)
pattern.sequence: first view: big cropped icon watermark in a top corner (~9%) · middle sections: light all-over texture (7%) · final section/sign-off: no pattern
never: as a separate decorative band/strip (tried and rejected)

highlight-brush.shape: irregular marker swipe, tapered ends, wavy non-parallel edges — never a rectangle or rounded pill
highlight-brush.frequency: ONCE per view/carousel — repetition kills it
highlight-brush.subject-rule: the subject stays OUTSIDE the swipe; only the predicate is swiped (شغموم | عند/وقت اللزوم يجملك). A short standalone term may be swiped whole.

dashed-lines.colour: gold on maroon, maroon (or gold) on sand
dashed-lines.use: ground lines under illustrations, guide lines that tie a drawing to the layout, simple dashed arrows pointing at an object
dashed-lines.reserved: the half-ellipse "cradle" arc under a word is reserved for عليك / عليه (it represents a scale)

wordmark-ar.note: used in carousel header rows and tight spaces

wordmark-en.note: Latin line alone — only for Latin-only contexts

icon.note: four-point star with an S; avatar, favicon, watermark

logo.clear-space (proposed): lockup/wordmark: X = height of the SHOGHMOUM line (≈22% of lockup height) on every side · icon: ½ icon height
logo.min-size (proposed): lockup 140px wide · Arabic wordmark 96px · icon 24px (favicon 16px uses the dedicated favicon file)
colours: maroon on gold / sand on black (highlight covers only)
black or white only where brand colours are technically impossible
